Halt Summary 0

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:

Size:

Source:

Description

Read-only. Each bit indicates whether one specific hart is halted. Unavailable/nonexistent harts are not considered halted. LSB for hart {hartsel[19:5],5'h0}, MSB for hart {hartsel[19:5],5'h1f}.
